short.en: Open MikroTik routers from GLPI using Winbox and manage router configuration backups.

long.en:
Adds a Winbox connection tab to GLPI network equipment records. Store per-device connection details, launch the locally installed Winbox client through a short-lived one-time handoff, review launch events, and manage RouterOS configuration exports and backups. Optional PuTTY and KiTTY launch handlers are provided for SSH access.
Version 0.4.6 is a free public beta exercised on GLPI 11.0.9. It has no subscription, purchase, or formal support service. Connect IT monitors the public issue tracker and considers fixes and improvements on a best-effort basis. Compatibility and security review are ongoing.
